name: Drain Fafnir (Black Edition)
description: The same left-spin layer in funeral black. Nothing about the shape changed — what changed is how much it keeps. Where Drain Fafnir takes a share of what hits it, the Black Edition takes the hit itself, the spin behind it, and the stamina that was going to pay for the next one.

abilities.name: Void Drain
abilities.description: Drain Spin, doubled and then some. Steals **1.2 stamina** from the attacker, heals **26** from the theft, and cuts **22%** off the hit that fed it. Every third hit taken bursts for 70 true damage — Fafnir has been full for a while by then.

special_move.name: Nothing Break
special_move.description: Fafnir absorbs the charge and gives none of it back, draining the stadium dry in two long pulls.
flavour_texts: 🖤 **Nothing Break** — the black layer gives nothing back!
